_readme: Single source of truth for every property transaction rate the site quotes.
js/costs.js renders whatever is in here — no rate is written into the code.
IMPORTANT: 'verified' below is false. These figures were seeded from the
Finance Act 2024 and have NOT been confirmed against the current Act by a
human. While it is false the calculator says so on the page, in amber, and
refuses to present itself as authoritative. Set it to true, with your name
and the date, once you have checked each line against FBR and the relevant
.github/workflows/tax-watch.yml re-fetches every source below on a schedule,
and opens an issue when one of them changes or when this file predates the
most recent 1 July. It deliberately does not try to parse rates out of them:
a mis-parsed tax rate on a live estate agency site costs a client money.

sources.label: Punjab Board of Revenue — stamp duty & registration
ICT / FBR — capital value tax, Islamabad

236K.label: Advance income tax on purchase
236K.note: Adjustable against your annual income tax — it is not money gone, it is money paid early. Non-filers pay it as a penalty and cannot adjust it if they never file.

236C.label: Advance income tax on sale
236C.note: Also adjustable for a filer. Deducted by the registering authority at the time of transfer.

cgt.label: Capital gains tax on sale
cgt.note: Applies to the gain, not the price. For property acquired on or after 1 July 2024 the holding period no longer reduces it for filers. Property bought before that date is still on the older holding-period slabs — tell me the purchase date and I will work it out properly.

other.label: Society transfer fee
other.note: Set by the society, not by law — DHA, Bahria and the rest each have their own schedule, usually a fixed amount per marla. Ask me for the current one on your file.

other.label: Agent commission
other.note: Mine is 1% from each side, in writing, and I do not take anything from the other party's agent.
